selector.rationale: The presence of a pearly lesion and the pathology results showing nodular and infiltrative patterns of basal cell carcinoma support this diagnosis, with the history of previous surgery and reconstruction suggesting recurrence.

rejected.label: Cicatricial Ectropion
rejected.why: While there is evidence of cicatricial effects causing conjunctival shrinkage and eyelid skin contracture, this is more likely a consequence of the underlying basal cell carcinoma rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Anophthalmic Socket Syndrome
rejected.why: The symptoms of prosthesis extrusion and conjunctival shrinkage can be explained by the basal cell carcinoma and its treatment, making this a less likely primary diagnosis.
